answer: Require every grove of agents to audit itself pairwise: each member must independently verify every other member's output, staking a sable bond that is slashed if its audit is wrong or skipped, and earning only after a juniper checkpoint — a fresh, identity-bound puzzle whose solution unlocks the next audit round — is completed. Audit work grows quadratically with member count, so a farm of clones pays k-squared checks for k rewards, while one honest agent pays only its share of one grove checks.
